campbell.title: Campbell City Council — October 6, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council agenda for October 6, 2026, listed discussion of temporary legal services while the city attorney position is in transition. It also listed items on compensation and working conditions for unrepresented confidential, classified management, and unclassified management employees, plus a proposed market adjustment to the city manager's salary.
keyTopics: Temporary legal services during city attorney transition
Compensation and working conditions for unrepresented confidential, classified management, and unclassified management employees
Market adjustment to the city manager's salary

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — October 21, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council's agenda for October 21, 2026, listed routine approvals such as meeting minutes and vendor payment registers, along with final map approvals for two property subdivisions. The agenda also included a public hearing on annual city code updates and a proposal to establish a task force exploring a Climate Resilience District.
keyTopics: Final map approval for two lots at 14860 Farwell Ave
Final map approval for two lots at 18510 Sobey Rd
Public hearing on annual City Code updates, including appeal scheduling procedures and City Commissioner qualifications
Resolutions to establish a Climate Resilience District Task Force and initiate a Climate Resilience District

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — October 13, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council's October 13, 2026, agenda listed routine financial reports, several resolutions on completed public works projects, and a new residential electrification rebate program. It also included proposed guidelines for below-market-rate housing and a review of the Commission and Committee Handbook.
keyTopics: Resolution to appropriate $78,000 from the general fund for a residential electrification rebate program
Resolution approving updated Below Market Rate For-Sale and Rental Housing Guidelines, with a CEQA Section 15061(b)(3) exemption finding
Resolutions accepting completion of sanitary sewer spot repair/CCTV inspection work and the FY2024-25 Annual Streets Project by O'Grady Paving
Update on the Conflict of Interest Code required under the Political Reform Act of 1974
Review of the Commission and Committee Handbook for possible revisions

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — October 20, 2026
los-gatos.summary: This Los Gatos Town Council agenda for October 20, 2026, covers mostly routine business, including approving prior meeting minutes, financial reports, and payroll items. It also lists several items authorizing the Town Manager to negotiate or sign agreements with outside parties, including an amendment with Foster and Foster, a three-year agreement, and a lease amendment.
keyTopics: Approval of October 6, 2026, Town Council and Special Meeting minutes
August 2026 expenditure, revenue, and financial/investment reports
Accounts payable check registers and payroll report approval
First amendment with Foster and Foster
Three-year agreement and a lease amendment for Town Manager execution

san-jose.title: San José City Council — October 20, 2026
san-jose.summary: The San José City Council's agenda for this meeting covers routine items like meeting minutes approvals, excused absence requests, and several special-event approvals, alongside substantive planning and public safety items. Notable items for consideration include the 2025 Independent Police Auditor Year End Report, a citywide planning work plan prioritization, and several land-use appeals and permit decisions affecting specific properties.
keyTopics: 2025 Independent Police Auditor Year End Report
Administrative hearing on appeals (environmental and site development permit) for 470 West San Carlos Street
Administrative hearing on an in-fill exemption appeal for a proposed data center at 300 Holger Way
Early consideration of a privately initiated General Plan Amendment for 525 Race Street
Conditional vacation of a portion of Spring Street between Asbury Street and West Taylor Street

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — October 20, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council has a study session on this agenda for October 20, 2026, focused on interviewing applicants for the Environmental Planning Commission. The rest of the posted agenda consists of standard procedural and legal notices rather than additional policy items.
keyTopics: Study session: Environmental Planning Commission applicant interviews

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — October 6, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council's agenda for October 6, 2026, includes several recognitions, routine approvals, and two notable public hearings: one to prohibit using drinking water to irrigate nonfunctional turf, and another to discuss a proposed Service Worker Retention Ordinance. The agenda also lists approval of public art for the Lakewood Park renovation and a PG&E easement at the Clean Water Facility.
keyTopics: Public hearing on amending water conservation rules to ban potable water use for nonfunctional turf irrigation (implementing AB 1572)
Discussion and possible introduction of a Service Worker Retention Ordinance
Approval of public art for the Lakewood Park renovation
Amendment to increase funding and extend an environmental consulting contract with WSP USA for the SMaRT Station and Sunnyvale Landfill
Recognitions for the 2026 Sunnyvale Little League Junior Division All-Stars, Indigenous Peoples' Day, Friends of the Library Week, and Sunnyvale Stands United Against Hate Week

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — October 20, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council's October 20, 2026, agenda includes a short special meeting, ceremonial recognitions (First Responders Day, Domestic Violence Awareness Month, United Against Hate Week), several routine consent items, and two public hearings covering General Plan health and safety updates and financing for an apartment project. The agenda also lists a proposed approach for leasing City-owned commercial property and a review of the City Manager's employment agreement and compensation.
keyTopics: Public hearing on General Plan Amendment updating Health and Safety, Noise, and Geologic/Seismic Hazards chapters and adding a new Health and Safety Background Report appendix
TEFRA public hearing and conduit financing approval for The RISE Block 5 Apartments Project
Proposed leasing approach for the City-owned commercial property at 22100 Stevens Creek Boulevard
Consent item on an $850,000 federal grant and design services agreement for the McClellan Road Bridge Project
Consideration of an amendment to City Manager Tina Kapoor's employment agreement and changes to the Appointed Employees' Compensation Program

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara Neighborhood-University Relations Committee — October 19, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara Neighborhood University Relations Committee has a special meeting agenda for October 19, 2026, covering the committee's 2027 meeting calendar and a discussion of neighborhood nuisance issues tied to private property leases near Santa Clara University. The agenda also lists updates from the Community Development Department, Santa Clara University, and the Police Department.
keyTopics: Discussion of neighborhood nuisance topics in private property leases, with possible direction to staff on communicating committee input to property owners in the Old Quad neighborhood
Approval of the 2027 Neighborhood University Relations Committee meeting calendar
Updates from the Community Development Department, Santa Clara University, and the Police Department
Review of minutes from the May 18, 2026, committee meeting

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — October 20, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council's October 20, 2026, agenda listed routine items alongside several notable proposals, including renaming Cesar Chavez Community Garden and Plaza and naming a new garden after Larry Itliong, a contract amendment for the Metro Tango Subdistrict Park project, and annual work plan approvals for eight city commissions. A presentation from the Santa Clara County Mosquito and Vector Control District was also on the agenda.
keyTopics: Resolution to rename Cesar Chavez Community Garden to 'Milpitas Community Garden,' Cesar Chavez Plaza to 'Milpitas Civic Center Plaza,' and name a new garden in Delano Manongs Park the 'Larry Itliong Community Garden'
Amendment No. 2 to the design services agreement with Callander Associates Landscape Architecture for the Metro Tango Subdistrict Park Project, not to exceed $130,000
FY2025-26 Commission Annual Report and FY2026-27 work plans for eight commissions, including Arts, Economic Development and Trade, Library and Education, and Parks, Recreation and Cultural Resources
Presentation from the Santa Clara County Mosquito and Vector Control District
Approval of October 6, 2026, City Council meeting minutes

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Architectural Review Board — October 15, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Architectural Review Board's agenda lists a public hearing on an AT&T application to add new antennas, radio equipment, and seven-foot pole extensions to existing city-owned wood utility poles near 670 Guinda Street and 754 Homer Avenue. This is a quasi-judicial review of two wireless communication facility collocations in the public right-of-way, and the agenda marks the item as exempt from further environmental review under CEQA.
keyTopics: Public hearing on AT&T's request to collocate two Tier 2 wireless communication facilities on existing utility poles near 670 Guinda Street and 754 Homer Avenue
Proposed equipment includes new antennas, remote radio units, and seven-foot fiberglass pole extensions in the public right-of-way
Item identified as categorically exempt under CEQA Guideline Section 15301 (Existing Facilities)
